screen.subject: 交渉 議事録（案）
screen.line: 結論：契約にこぎつける

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 13: 25 words — meetings & paperwork.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to an office chat between a section chief and a team member.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Kimura, are the minutes from yesterday's negotiation ready?
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Yes. At first they were reluctant about the price, but in the end we agreed.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Good. After all those discussions, we finally got to a contract.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Yes. In the end the department manager made the call.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: In the minutes, please keep the conclusion and their demands separate.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Understood. For what came by phone, I'll only include what I read back and confirmed.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Next, about next month's shareholders' meeting. This year it's being held to mark our 30th anniversary.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: We'll need to check how the meeting's proceedings will run as well.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Yes. Also, I'm giving the presentation, so could you make the charts for the proposal?
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Certainly. I'll put them together so the point of the proposal comes across.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Thanks. The department manager pointed out the last materials had too much text.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: I'll be careful. Also, there was a mistake on the seminar application form, so I corrected it and sent it again.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: The application deadline is tomorrow, isn't it? Did you put 'Correction' in the email's subject line?
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Yes, and I fixed the itemised section too. By the way, I heard a rumour we're moving to a new office. Is it true?
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Nothing's been decided yet.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First: negotiation & conclusions.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Discussing terms with the other side.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We negotiated the price with the client.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Talking things over and sharing views.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The team discussed the new plan.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Showing reluctance, as in 難色を示す.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The department manager was reluctant about that proposal.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Two or more things coming out the same.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Everyone agreed.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: The final view reached in a discussion.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll reach the meeting's conclusion next week.
lines.name: 田中課長

segments.meaning: to hand down (a decision): 判断をくだす

lines.en: Handing down a decision or order.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The president made the final decision.
lines.name: 木村

segments.meaning: to manage to reach (契約にこぎつける)

lines.en: Managing to reach a goal after much effort.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: After three months we finally got to a contract.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Demanding something firmly.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The customer is demanding a quick response.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Pointing out a problem.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A senior colleague pointed out a mistake in my materials.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Next: meetings & presentations.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A meeting of all members.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The shareholders' meeting is next month.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: What a meeting discusses; its proceedings.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll check how the proceedings will run.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: A written record of a meeting.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll write up the minutes after the meeting.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Holding a meeting or event.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The trade show runs for three days.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Marking an event so it is remembered.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: There's a party to mark the company's founding.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Explaining a plan in front of people.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'm presenting a new project tomorrow.
lines.name: 田中課長

segments.meaning: repeating back to confirm (e.g. on the phone)

lines.en: Repeating back what you heard.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll read the phone number back to confirm it.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Talk that may or may not be true.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: There's a rumour that a new department manager is coming.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Last: documents.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A document setting out a proposal.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We sent the proposal to the customer.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Charts and tables.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Charts and tables make things easier to follow.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: The main aim of a talk or text.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll explain the purpose of the meeting first.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Applying, for example to take part.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Applications for the seminar close tomorrow.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: The form you fill in to apply.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Write your name and address on the application form.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Correcting a mistake.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I corrected the date on the materials.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: The title that says what an email is about.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Make your email subject lines clear.
lines.name: 木村

segments.meaning: itemized section headed 記 in a business letter

lines.en: The itemised part of a document, under the heading 記.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The date, time and place go in the itemised section.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: The department manager showed ___ about that proposal.

lines.en: Question 1. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 難色, reluctance.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: What is a written record of a meeting called?

lines.en: Question 2. What is a written record of a meeting called?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 3: 議事録.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: After three months we finally ___ a contract.

lines.en: Question 3. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 4: こぎつけました, managed to reach.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: I'll ___ the phone number to confirm it.

lines.en: Question 4. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: 復唱, read back.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: I ___ the date on the materials.

lines.en: Question 5. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 訂正, corrected.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today we studied 25 words: meetings & paperwork.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Review them again in the app's word list.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Good work today. See you in the next lesson.
lines.name: ナレーター
